title: Extract deal points from a Share Purchase Agreement
instructions: Read the attached Share Purchase Agreement in full. Extract every deal point into a table with: Deal point, Section, Value/Terms, and any conditions or cross-references that qualify it. The deal points must include purchase price and adjustments, escrow/holdback (amount and release conditions), indemnity basket/cap and carve-outs, closing conditions, termination rights and their triggers, restrictive covenants and durations, and governing law/forum. Where a deal point depends on a defined term, resolve the definition and note it.

inputs.name: spa-full.pdf
inputs.description: Share Purchase Agreement, 84 pages, heavy defined terms and cross-references.

inputs.name: extraction-schema.json
inputs.description: Required columns and accepted value formats.

sample_answer:
DEAL POINTS EXTRACTION — SPA

| Deal point | Section | Value/Terms | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Purchase price | 2.1 | USD 42,000,000, subject to working capital adjustment | Adjustment measured against 1.5M peg (s. 2.3) |
| Escrow | 2.5 | 10% of Purchase Price held 12 months | Released against indemnity claims; 'Losses' per s. 9.1 |
| Indemnity basket | 9.3 | 0.75% of Purchase Price | Deductible, not a tipping point |
| Indemnity cap | 9.4 | 15% of Purchase Price | Carve-outs: fraud, breach of s. 5 fundamental reps |
| Termination | 10.1 | Either party may terminate | Outside date 2027-03-31; regulatory failure; material breach uncured 30 days |
| Non-compete | 7.2 | 36 months, founder only | Geographic scope: states where Target operates |
| Governing law | 11.1 | Delaware | Exclusive forum: Delaware Court of Chancery |

rubric.criterion: Extracts purchase price mechanism including the working-capital adjustment
Captures escrow/holdback amount AND release conditions
Captures indemnity basket, cap, and carve-outs as separate fields
Lists termination rights with their actual triggers
Resolves defined terms the deal points depend on
Reports a deal point value that contradicts the agreement text (penalty)
Every row cites the SPA section it came from
Conditions/qualifiers column reflects the agreement's actual conditions
